answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a vault before it can vouch for others, with a slow, rate-limited onboarding so weight accrues gradually. An attacker who spawns a plume of fake identities faces a gale of costs: each fake needs its own stake and its own waiting period, so forging a thousand sybils costs a thousand stakes and weeks of patience, while an honest agent pays once. Slashing the vault stake when a vouched identity cheats makes the whole attack unprofitable.
